mapper.select: SELECT id, name, location_name as locationName, longitude, latitude, current_type as currentType, price, max_charge_voltage as maxChargeVoltage, max_charge_current as maxChargeCurrent, max_charge_power as maxChargePower, max_vehicles as maxVehicles, current_vehicles as currentVehicles, open_status as openStatus, open_time as openTime, close_time as closeTime, provider, image, description, rating, update_time as updateTime FROM public_charge_station WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public_charge_station ( name, location_name, longitude, latitude, current_type, price, max_charge_voltage, max_charge_current, max_charge_power, max_vehicles, current_vehicles, open_status, open_time, close_time, provider, image, description, rating, update_time ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{locationName}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{currentType}, #{price}, #{maxChargeVoltage}, #{maxChargeCurrent}, #{maxChargePower}, #{maxVehicles}, #{currentVehicles}, #{openStatus}, #{openTime}, #{closeTime}, #{provider}, #{image}, #{description}, #{rating}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO public_charge_station ( name, location_name, longitude, latitude, current_type, price, max_charge_voltage, max_charge_current, max_charge_power, max_vehicles, current_vehicles, open_status, open_time, close_time, provider, image, description, rating, update_time ) VALUES
( #{item.name}, #{item.locationName}, #{item.longitude}, #{item.latitude}, #{item.currentType}, #{item.price}, #{item.maxChargeVoltage}, #{item.maxChargeCurrent}, #{item.maxChargePower}, #{item.maxVehicles}, #{item.currentVehicles}, #{item.openStatus}, #{item.openTime}, #{item.closeTime}, #{item.provider}, #{item.image}, #{item.description}, #{item.rating}, NOW() )
